full_page.content:
1935, October
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 50 Cont.
Oct. 9 Dorothy A. Bartush - 8 - lost part of finger - fears loss of top of finger - Clarence Kirby - 82 - gall-stones ... very sick. Nora Kelly - 38 - sinus trouble .. Mrs. Mary Berendt - 34 - Bronchitis Violet & Ann Callewaert - 6 & 7 - fears infantile paral.
Page 51
Oct. 16th Mrs. (John) Hacker - Ankorville-62-wants a lady companion for winter - would be glad to board and room mother & child for sake of company. 2 mile from Church.
Eliz. Jane Bachor - 12 - mysterious .... can hardly walk since last May. Examined by seven different doctors. All at sea - acts like infantile Paral's
Edw'd Ruane - 39 - has wife and 3 - struggling on - discouraged ....
Mrs. M. Oak - 35 - Mother of 2 small children, fears operation for threatening tuomers (womb) - was enrolled March 10 for one year, feel- ing better for a time. Now starts perpetual enrollment in hopes of es- caping operation. Promises weekly Communion for a year ...
Salome Fryczyusk - 54 - asthma & heart, husband & Family.
Page 52 Oct. 14 Victor Carpaert - 52 - creeping paralysis. Drs. acknoledge helpless- ness to do anything. Enrolled To-day perpetualy and promise weekly communion if things improve ....
Rosemary Hallock - 8 - Complications - typhoid, etc. Drs. had little hope anointed this a.m. (5 Fr. Larkin) and % phone - prayers requested Father n.c. enrolls her To-night. - seems improving ...
De Bouw Family - Warren, Mich. - wants youth or young man to help on farm - fall & winter $3. per week and clothes - board.
Mrs. Catherine Shea - Rheumatism terrible pains etc. - missing Mass, etc.
